description: The class from `Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Testing` that boots the real app from its entry point, usually `Program`, for tests and hands out clients for it.
An in-memory ASP.NET Core server that processes requests without opening a network port, used by `WebApplicationFactory` in place of Kestrel.
The app or component a test exercises, here the whole HTTP pipeline from routing to the response.
A host builder callback that runs after the app's own registrations, so tests can replace services such as external gateways.
A factory method that returns a derived factory with extra configuration for one test, leaving the shared factory unchanged.
An `AuthenticationHandler<AuthenticationSchemeOptions>` registered only in tests that turns a request header into a signed-in user with chosen claims.
